St. Paul and the Viper

Richard Crashaw (G.) (c. 1613–1649)

A
CTS
 
XXVIII.
 3
.
P
AUL,
 fear thou nought; no poison bears this asp:
It seeks to learn the virtue of thy hand.
Not as a foe, but suppliant, it would clasp;
Not fear, but pity, it would fain command.
